content.introduction: The Ludwig Institute for Shared Economic Prosperity (LISEP) was founded in 2019 by Ludwig and his wife, Dr. Carol Ludwig, with a mission to improve the economic well-being of middle- and lower-income Americans through research and education. LISEP focuses on fact-based economic and policy research, including new indicators for unemployment, earnings, and cost of living to provide a more transparent view of the economic situation of all Americans. The institute's headquarters are in Washington, DC, United States, and it operates as a nonprofit in the research services industry.

Founded: 2019 [...] Description: LISEP Ludwig Institute for Shared Economic Prosperity is a company that aims to achieve shared economic prosperity for all Americans, particularly for middle- and low-income families. Their focus is on fact-based economic and policy research.

The Ludwig Institute for Shared Economic Prosperity (LISEP) was created in 2019 by Ludwig and his wife, Dr. Carol Ludwig. The mission of LISEP is to improve the economic well-being of middle- and lower-income Americans through research and education. LISEP's original economic research includes new indicators for unemployment, earnings, and cost of living. These metrics aim to provide policymakers and the public with a more transparent view of the economic situation of all Americans, [...] WASHINGTON, Aug. 13, 2025 /PRNewswire/ -- Prospects for workers seeking jobs paying above poverty wages worsened in July, particularly for Black and Hispanic earners, according to the latest report from the Ludwig Institute for Shared Economic Prosperity (LISEP).

These metrics aim to provide policymakers and the public with a more transparent view of the economic situation of all Americans, [...] WASHINGTON, June 18, 2025 /PRNewswire/ -- The percentage of American workers unable to secure full-time, above-poverty-wage jobs continues to tick upward, with nearly one-fourth now classified as "functionally unemployed," according to the latest report from the Ludwig Institute for Shared Economic Prosperity (LISEP).
